python3 - <<'PY'
import statistics

# NASA total outlays (on-budget + off-budget) from FFO-3 table
# NASA is entirely on-budget (no off-budget component)
# Values from FFO-3 for FY2008-2017 in millions of dollars:
nasa_millions = [17834, 19168, 18906, 17617, 17190, 16978, 17093, 18272, 18828, 18698]
years = list(range(2008, 2018))

print("NASA outlays (millions of dollars):")
for y, v in zip(years, nasa_millions):
    print(f"  FY{y}: {v}")

# Convert to billions
nasa_b = [v/1000 for v in nasa_millions]
print(f"\nIn billions: {[round(v,3) for v in nasa_b]}")

# 10% Winsorized mean & range
# n=10, trim fraction=0.10
# floor(n*t) = floor(10*0.10) = 1 → replace 1 lowest, 1 highest
n = len(nasa_b)
sorted_b = sorted(nasa_b)
k = int(n * 0.10)  # number to trim from each tail
print(f"\nn={n}, k={k}")

# Winsorized sample: replace k lowest with sorted_b[k], k highest with sorted_b[n-1-k]
winsorized = sorted_b[k:n-k]
winsorized = [sorted_b[k]] * k + sorted_b[k:n-k] + [sorted_b[n-1-k]] * k

print(f"Sorted values: {sorted_b}")
print(f"Winsorized values: {winsorized}")

winsorized_mean = statistics.mean(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized mean: {winsorized_mean}")

# Winsorized range = max - min of winsorized sample
winsorized_range = max(winsorized) - min(winsorized)
print(f"10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range}")
print(f"  Lower bound (Winsorized min): {min(winsorized)}")
print(f"  Upper bound (Winsorized max): {max(winsorized)}")
print(f"  Range rounded to hundredths: {round(winsorized_range, 2)}")

# Sanity check: the range is just the difference between 2nd smallest and 2nd largest
lower = sorted_b[1]   # 2nd smallest
upper = sorted_b[-2]   # 2nd largest
print(f"\nDirect check: {upper} - {lower} = {upper - lower}")
print(f"Rounded: {round(upper-lower, 2)}")
PY
